target.title: fix(usage): show provider quota in usage footer
target.body:
Fixes #7379

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users who enable `/usage tokens` or `/usage full` would only see per-response token/cost details and still need to run `/status` separately to see active-provider quota windows such as GitHub Copilot Premium/Chat usage.

## Why This Change Was Made

This change reuses the existing provider-usage summary and formatter seams to append a compact active-provider quota summary to the reply usage footer when available. Provider fetching stays plugin-owned, the whole footer usage lookup is hard-timeout-bounded and omit-on-failure, and cost/session footer behavior remains limited to the existing `/usage full` path.

## User Impact

Users can now see provider quota windows directly in each `/usage tokens` or `/usage full` reply footer when their active provider exposes them. If credentials are missing, the usage endpoint is unavailable, or the quota lookup never resolves, replies still show the normal token/cost footer without failing or stalling indefinitely.

## Evidence

- Current head: `8d01d47e727495abd0443770c9e8213eb8262a2f`.
- Merge repair: merged latest `upstream/main` (`f6b99012435391f18b701330c7b6f40248e6b61c`) into the PR branch with merge, resolving the conflict and keeping the provider-quota footer path intact.
- Docs repair: restored `docs/reference/token-use.md` coverage for `/usage tokens` and `/usage full` provider quota windows, including omit-on-missing-credentials, provider-usage failure, and timeout behavior.
- Current-head light verification: `git diff --check` -> passed; `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` -> passed; `node scripts/docs-list.js | Select-String -SimpleMatch "reference\token-use.md"` -> listed `reference\token-use.md`; `npx --yes oxfmt@0.57.0 --check --threads=1 --config .oxfmtrc.jsonc docs/reference/token-use.md` -> passed.
- Claim proved by existing focused proof: `/usage full` and `/usage tokens` reply footers append the active provider quota summary when provider usage data is available; provider quota failure and a never-resolving provider usage lookup preserve the normal reply usage footer and omit quota text; the whole reply-footer provider usage lookup is bounded before final reply delivery; `auth-profile` request shaping falls back to concrete configured auth-mode resolution before quota-provider gating.
- Earlier focused commands on prior heads remain relevant for the unchanged runtime path: auto-reply reply-runner Vitest passed the quota success/failure/timeout cases, provider usage formatter tests passed, oxfmt passed on the touched reply-footer files, and isolated live GitHub Copilot proof produced a quota footer once a provider usage snapshot was available.

AI-assisted: yes. I used AI assistance to inspect the relevant reply-footer and provider-usage code paths, resolve the merge conflict, restore the docs evidence, choose focused validation, and update this evidence. I reviewed the final diff and understand the submitted change.
